name: Sanjou Gin
source:
Gin took a long absence from Kimisaki Academy so that she could train intensively to become a warrior. After she came back, she started teaching the younger members of the Kendo Team herself. Gin loves sparring with people that are talented in martial arts.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
